test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 2nd December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/87d551d9066a53e0d8089bbf3d3af5147e5aa1aef43f7ec367f078d8cce97b25.png]
solution:
The figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series is shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0d7d4f615b4563e659378cbaf3ec2c97dbd36ae1e9662d6e65688e34d7b9e6db.png] 

1) Rectangle - It is shifting in clockwise direction at corners only and with every shift it also rotating vertically and horizontally alternately.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/acf35b4cec5e31b9e93ffaf27a02acc3366ee5927c705637252e0a4a3f4c5e23.png] 

2) Square - It is shifting in clockwise direction at the corners only.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e8aeb16b4b578ffec22b1272da336d63bceb7b1806bde630a9a626366f77e3d1.png] 

3) Circle - It is shifting in clockwise direction at the corners only.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/194b19482f35415e6d663c311ac3b574b885f20a9e617b6e9e4b5e42f3723d20.png] 

4) Rhombus - It is shifting in clockwise direction at the corners only and with every shift it also rotating vertically and horizontally alternately.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6850854170923c486a84a6c57c8bce5ee0cbcade5c889ba8ceefc63375a2208a.png] 

5) Triangle - It is not shifting from its position but rotating at same position in the clockwise direction.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c65f9e8edead1e5bea33b88ea2554bcfffb2912d6a799afef1bee9391cb655f7.png] 

Thus, the final series is :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/95df0a6c3fa734fdd86ecc24d2c207cc6288b0590df61dfe0d6449d7179511a4.png] 

Hence, ‘option - (4)’ is the correct answer.
